_comment: Track split for the master timeline: each History track becomes an event track (the existing row, id preserved — the 288 point-dated notes stay put) plus a NEW condition track (legacy range notes are re-filed onto it). Track names and display questions below are Claude's overnight drafts against the plan's requirements — reword freely; re-running the op with edited prose updates the rows in place (idempotent).

event.displayQuestion: What happened to this character before the start of TLTT, and when?

condition.displayQuestion: Over what periods was a sustained state true of this character's life (an upbringing, an occupation, an exile), from when to when?
condition.auditDirective: All backstory should have a reveal somewhere in the project.

event.displayQuestion: What happened between the two characters before the story starts, and when?

condition.displayQuestion: Over what periods did a sustained state of the relationship hold (estrangement, partnership, rivalry), from when to when?

event.displayQuestion: When was the system established, reformed, or brought down — what happened, and when?

condition.displayQuestion: Over what period was the system in force, and what standing effects did it have on the story world while it held?

event.displayQuestion: What happened to the organization — formation, splits, turning points, dissolution — and when? (Can be empty if formed during TLTT)

condition.displayQuestion: Over what periods was the organization operating, and what was it doing while it operated?

event.displayQuestion: When was it invented, adopted, banned, or superseded — what happened, and when?

condition.displayQuestion: Over what period was it in use, and by whom?

event.displayQuestion: When did in-universe study of this world truth advance — who discovered or established what, and when?
event.usageDirective: What the characters say on page should not contradict the in-universe timeline of understanding and study established here. Refer to the world date.

condition.displayQuestion: Over what periods did a given in-universe understanding of the world truth hold, and how did characters' understanding evolve across them?
condition.usageDirective: What the characters say on page should not contradict the in-universe timeline of understanding and study established here. Refer to the world date.
